criteria.name: Identity and GIS footprint fidelity
criteria.evidence: Purdue GIS OBJECTID 615; 53 trace vertices and 52 structural wall segments documented in R2 validation.
criteria.limitations: GIS campus footprint is not a surveyed facade outline.

criteria.name: Placement, orientation, scale, and interior layout
criteria.evidence: Identity root and existing local frame retained; module bounds and floor-map comparisons documented.
criteria.limitations: Road School maps have no scale or north arrow; Ringel/HSSE offsets are approximate; master placement marker not independently checked.

criteria.name: Floors, height, and roof form
criteria.evidence: Archival evidence supports three floors in the central portion; oblique render shows current roof treatment.
criteria.limitations: Wall height, overall height, roof elevation and rooftop shapes remain estimates; roof reads as broad and featureless.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive identity
criteria.evidence: Purdue Events photo and R2 entry render show the updated six-column portico, pediment, landing, and broad stairs.
criteria.limitations: Glazed entry/doors are not legible; brick/window grid remains behind portico; handrail pieces appear disconnected; historic library/Fowler Hall volumes are not distinguishable.

criteria.name: Modular integrity, portability, and evidence quality
criteria.evidence: Matching fresh-reopen hash; named collection/root; no materialless meshes or missing external images; GIS, map, photo, and render evidence present.
criteria.limitations: Master marker and building-specific dimensions are not verified.

findings: R2 is a real visual improvement over R1 but remains below the 8.0 threshold.
The entrance needs a recessed glazed vestibule and visible doors; the facade grid should not continue behind the portico.
Refine portico depth, capitals/fluting, cornice and connected stair rails using photo evidence.
Keep height, roof, and module placement estimates labeled until dimensioned or georeferenced evidence is available.
Verify the Stewart Center instance marker in the campus master separately.
